CBB.name: Cassava Bacterial Blight
CBB.cause: A bacterium called Xanthomonas axonopodis pv. manihotis.
CBB.spread: Rain splash, infected cuttings, and contaminated farm tools.
CBB.symptoms: Angular brown spots on leaves, wilting, and dieback of shoots. Gum may ooze from stems.
CBB.management: Remove and destroy infected plants. Do not take cuttings from diseased plants. Clean tools between plants.
CBB.prevention: Plant certified disease-free cuttings. Choose tolerant varieties if available.
CBB.see_extension_officer: If many plants show spots or wilting, contact your local agricultural extension officer.

CBSD.name: Cassava Brown Streak Disease
CBSD.symptoms: Yellow patches on leaves, brown streaks on stems, and brown, rotten patches inside the roots.
CBSD.management: There is no cure for the virus. Remove infected plants early. Do not use their cuttings.
CBSD.prevention: Plant certified disease-free cuttings. Control whiteflies. Choose tolerant varieties if available.
CBSD.see_extension_officer: Contact an extension officer as soon as you see stem streaks, because the roots can be damaged even when leaves look mostly healthy.

CGM.name: Cassava Green Mottle
CGM.symptoms: Green and yellow mottled patterns on leaves and sometimes leaf distortion.
CGM.management: There is no cure for the virus. Remove infected plants. Do not use their cuttings.
CGM.prevention: Plant certified disease-free cuttings. Keep fields free of weeds that can host the virus.
CGM.see_extension_officer: Contact an extension officer if the mottling spreads across your field.

CMD.name: Cassava Mosaic Disease
CMD.symptoms: Yellow and green mosaic patterns on leaves, distorted leaves, and stunted plants.
CMD.management: There is no cure for the virus. Remove infected plants. Do not use their cuttings.
CMD.prevention: Plant certified disease-free cuttings. Control whiteflies. Choose tolerant varieties, which are the most effective protection.
CMD.see_extension_officer: Contact an extension officer if many plants show mosaic symptoms.

Healthy.name: Healthy Cassava Leaf
Healthy.symptoms: Leaves show even green colour with no spots, mottling, or distortion.
Healthy.prevention: Use clean, certified cuttings. Remove weeds and inspect plants often.
Healthy.see_extension_officer: Contact an extension officer if you notice any new symptoms.
